title.value: Find unclaimed money and start the claim

introduction.value: Meta's Muse agent found over $1,500 in unclaimed funds in about five minutes and helped fill out paperwork; the claim was filed but unpaid.

method.value: Nick Grous, an investment analyst at ARK Invest, asked Meta's Muse agent to search the internet for money that might belong to him. Muse returned a list of unclaimed property and funds under his name and helped complete much of the paperwork. Grous then filed the official claim himself.

outcome.value: Muse found more than $1,500 in about five minutes. Grous had not received any money when the article ran, because government offices still have to verify and approve the claim.

notes.value: Approval isn't guaranteed. You still verify and submit the claim yourself, and Muse asks permission before sensitive actions such as sending email. Muse was US-only at launch.

source_text.body:
Find unclaimed money and start the claim
Meta's Muse agent found over $1,500 in unclaimed funds in about five minutes and helped fill out paperwork; the claim was filed but unpaid.
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
Nick Grous, an investment analyst at ARK Invest, asked Meta's Muse agent to search the internet for money that might belong to him. Muse returned a list of unclaimed property and funds under his name and helped complete much of the paperwork. Grous then filed the official claim himself.
How it went
Muse found more than $1,500 in about five minutes. Grous had not received any money when the article ran, because government offices still have to verify and approve the claim.
Worth knowing
Approval isn't guaranteed. You still verify and submit the claim yourself, and Muse asks permission before sensitive actions such as sending email. Muse was US-only at launch.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Search the official unclaimed property sites for [state(s) I have lived in] and [national site if relevant] using my name [full name] and variations like [maiden name, nicknames, old addresses]. List every match with the amount, holder and state. For any claim, walk me through the paperwork, prefill what you can, and pause to show me the form before submitting anything or entering my SSN.
Original source: https://colombiaone.com/2026/09/29/meta-muse-ai-agent/
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

introduction.en: An analyst used Meta Muse to look for property or funds registered in his name.
introduction.zh: 一位分析师用 Meta Muse 查找登记在自己名下的财产或资金。

method.en: ARK Invest analyst Nick Grous asked Meta Muse to search for money potentially belonging to him. It returned possible unclaimed property matches under his name.
method.zh: ARK Invest分析师Nick Grous让Meta Muse搜索可能属于自己的资金，得到本人名下未领取财产的可能匹配。

method.en: Muse helped prepare much of the paperwork, but Grous submitted the official claim himself.
method.zh: Muse辅助准备大部分材料，正式申领由Grous本人提交。

outcome.en: The account describes more than $1,500 found in roughly five minutes. No money had been received when the article was published.
outcome.zh: 叙述称约五分钟找到逾1,500美元；文章发布时尚未收到资金。

notes.en: Government identity checks and approval were still required. The source says Muse sought permission for sensitive actions and was US-only at launch; these describe that launch context, not current availability.
notes.zh: 仍须政府身份核验与批准；源站称Muse在敏感动作前要求许可，且首发仅限美国，这些是当时语境而非当前可用性保证。
